stations.title: Deshawn
stations.say: The log is full of passwords.

stations.title: Sign in page
stations.text: Customers type an email and a password.

stations.title: Portal log
stations.text: Read by the team and contractors.

captions: Last, Deshawn hears from the contractor that the portal log is full of passwords.
Every sign in writes the password, the session or a hash where many people can read it.
You catch the leak, keep the secrets out and write the test, in three tasks.
Now the log says who signed in and how it went, and nothing anyone could reuse.
Same sign in, same log. The secrets stay where they belong.
